description: Environment setup - install Vitest and verify baseline build passes
steps: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npm install
Run: npx prisma generate to ensure generated client exists
Run: POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://placeholder:placeholder@localhost:5432/placeholder npm run build to confirm baseline build passes
Install vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 as dev dependencies: npm install -D vitest @vitest/coverage-v8
Create vitest.config.ts at project root with path aliases matching tsconfig (@ -> src/), test environment 'node', include pattern 'src/**/*.test.ts'
Add 'test' script to package.json: 'vitest run', add 'test:watch' script: 'vitest'
Run npm run lint to confirm no lint issues introduced
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with placeholder POSTGRES_URL
vitest.config.ts exists with correct path alias configuration
package.json has test and test:watch scripts
npx vitest run exits cleanly (0 tests found is acceptable at this stage)
verification: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://p:p@localhost:5432/p npm run build
source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npx vitest run
findings: Pre-existing lint error in src/app/profile/page.tsx (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) - not introduced by this change. Vitest config uses passWithNoTests to exit cleanly when no test files exist. Vite shows a deprecation warning about ESM in CommonJS but it is non-blocking.
